description: Fortran is a language used for science and number-heavy work. It has strong tools for arrays. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install GNU Fortran. Save each example as lesson.f90, run gfortran -std=f2008 lesson.f90 -o lesson, then run it.
versionNote: Examples use Fortran 2008 features supported by GNU Fortran 10 or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Group numbers in an array with Fortran
Return a calculated value with Fortran
learningObjectives: Read an array position with Fortran
Change selected array items with Fortran
